يعلوليان (form XII)
# يَعْلَوْلِيَانِ (yaʕlawliyāni) /jaʕ.law.li.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# يُعْلَوْلَيَانِ (yuʕlawlayāni) /juʕ.law.la.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
